text: dsh-visual 是供 DSH Web 对话使用的交互卡片插件。它注册 visual 工具，并在消息流中呈现 HTML 卡片或可编辑流程图；工具会等待用户提交后再把结果交回会话。用户可以点击卡片动作、填写字段、保存脚本状态、右键添加带定位信息的评论，也可以拖动和调整流程图节点与连线。卡片支持自定义标题、尺寸、动作和等待时限，提交内容作为工具结果返回。适合需要在 DSH 对话中审阅内容、收集选择和备注，或共同修改流程图的场景。安装需要兼容版本的 DSH、Web 客户端和 Node.js 20 或更高版本，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-visual renders interactive HTML cards and editable flowcharts in DSH Web chats. Its visual tool waits for a user submission and returns actions, form fields, and comments. Users can also edit diagram nodes and edges. Requires compatible DSH and Node.js 20+.
我想让 DSH 在聊天里展示一张能点击操作的卡片。
能不能在对话中放一个表单，等我填写后再继续？
我想在生成的页面上标注意见，并把评论交回给模型。
有没有办法在聊天里拖动节点修改流程图？
让交互卡片的按钮、字段和状态一起作为工具结果返回。
卡片一直等不到回应怎么办？我希望它能超时或随会话取消。
I want an interactive card in chat that waits for my choice before the assistant continues.
Can I edit a flowchart by dragging nodes and then return the updated graph?
dsh-visual 的功能「交互式 HTML 卡片」：在对话消息中呈现模型提供的 HTML 内容。用户点击标记的动作或提交字段后，卡片将动作、字段和评论作为结果交回；工具在用户提交前保持等待。
dsh-visual 的功能「流程图编辑」：传入节点和连线后显示可调整的流程图。用户可以拖动、重命名、连接或删除图中元素，完成后交还编辑后的图结构。
dsh-visual 的功能「卡片评论」：用户可以在 HTML 卡片中的元素上右键添加文字意见。评论会关联元素定位信息，并随提交内容返回，帮助模型理解意见对应的位置。
dsh-visual 的功能「等待时限与取消」：卡片工具可以设置等待时长，默认等待十分钟并将范围限制在一秒到一小时。等待超时或会话取消时，工具返回相应结果。
dsh-visual 使用须知：HTML 卡片脚本的行为说明存在不一致：README 说脚本会运行，但工具参数描述称脚本会被移除，浏览器端实现则会执行卡片内联脚本。

Interactive cards inside a DeepSeek Harness conversation. The model publishes a self-contained HTML card (or a draggable flowchart), the tool **blocks until the user submits**, and the user's click, comments, form fields and card state come back as the tool result.
dsh-visual README · dsh-visual：No assistant text, no chat message, no artifact preview — a real card in the message stream.

dsh-visual README · Features：- **Blocking, not fire-and-forget.** `visual` stays pending until the user submits, so the answer arrives as the tool result and the agent continues in the same turn.
- **Scriptable cards.** Inline `<script>` runs per card through a small bridge (`dshVisual.root`, `dshVisual.setState`), so cards can toggle, validate and prefill themselves.
- **Structured answers.** Buttons (`data-visual-action`), inputs (`data-visual-field`), comments and card state are merged into one JSON answer.
- **Comments with pins.** Right-click any element to leave a comment; the answer carries the element's selector and label so the model knows exactly what each note is about.
- **Flow editor.** Pass a `flow` graph instead of HTML: drag nodes, double-click to rename, connect, delete, then hand the edited graph back.
- **Parallel safe.** Several cards in one turn each get their own bridge and state; nothing leaks between them.
- **Cancellable and time-bounded.** `timeoutMs` and a stop button turn the card read-only instead of hanging forever.

dsh-visual README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.1 and newer, below 0.3 (prerelease builds included)
- Node.js 20 or newer

dsh-visual README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-visual
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness once so the host half loads. After that, changes to `lib/client.js` only need a page refresh (⌘R).

For local development, link the directory instead:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-visual
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-visual   # uninstall
```

dsh-visual README · Parameters：| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | Card header title. |
| `html` | string | Complete, self-contained HTML document. Styles are scoped; scripts run per card. |
| `flow` | object | Flow graph `{nodes, edges}` rendered as an editable canvas instead of HTML. |
| `data` | object | Initial state exposed as `dshVisual.data` to the card script. |
| `height` | number | Initial card height in px (160–900). The card can resize itself. |
| `actions` | array | Action registry `{id, label}` for the footer chips and button labels. |
| `timeoutMs` | number | How long to wait for a submit (default 10 min, max 1 h). |
dsh-visual README · Parameters：Every field is optional except one of `html` or `flow`.

dsh-visual README · Buttons and fields：- `data-visual-action="id"` — clicking submits that action together with the fields, state and comments.
- `data-visual-field="name"` — read from the card on submit and returned under `answer.payload.fields`.
- The footer always shows a neutral **交还** button (`answer.action = "done"`). It never implies approval: review cards should carry an explicit approve/revise action of their own.
dsh-visual README · Comments：Right-click any element inside the card, type a note, and it is pinned with a number. The answer carries them in `answer.comments` as `{ selector, label, text }`.

dsh-visual README · Timeout and cancel：When `timeoutMs` elapses the call returns `action: "timeout"`; stopping the turn returns `action: "cancelled"`. In both cases the card becomes read-only and its footer explains why.

dsh-visual README · Development：```bash
npm run check        # syntax of both entries + docs/code consistency guard
npm pack --dry-run   # inspect the published file list
```

The client half is a hand-written module-loader bundle, so no build step is required.

dsh-visual README · Releasing：Publishing is automatic: pushing a `v*` tag runs the release workflow, which verifies `npm run check`, publishes to npm with provenance, and opens a GitHub Release.

```bash
npm version patch   # or minor / major
git push --follow-tags
```

dsh-visual README · Releasing：Publishing uses npm [trusted publishing](https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers/): the workflow exchanges the GitHub OIDC token for a short-lived npm credential, so no `NPM_TOKEN` secret is stored. Configure it once under the package's **Settings → Trusted publishing** on npmjs.com (owner `MjxUpUp`, repository `dsh-visual`, workflow `publish.yml`).
